info.title: Goshikq Runtime API
info.description: Outcome-driven agent runtime: runs, worker protocol, execution events, approvals, verification, metrics.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return events with sequence greater than this value.

get.summary:
Server-Sent Events stream for one run. Resumable via `Last-Event-ID` (sequence) or
`?after=`. Persisted events are replayed first, then live events; duplicates are
filtered by sequence. Ends with `event: end` once a terminal event has been sent.

post.summary:
Validates against the shared workflow schema; invalid definitions are rejected with
the full issue list so the builder can highlight them unless `draft` is true.

permissions.description: Permissions granted to this agent; tools requiring other permissions are rejected.

token.description: Plaintext shown once. Store it; the server keeps only a hash.

applied.description: False if the decision had already been recorded (idempotent replay).

CapabilityLevel.description: How completely a surface is implemented for a framework adapter.

project_id.description: Only honored when `GOSHIKQ_AUTH_MODE=none` (local bootstrap / isolation tests).

correlation_id.description: Shared parent/child correlation id. Defaults to the parent run id.

defer_start.description: Persist the run without spawning an executor. Used for coordinators waiting on children.

has_state_provider.description: Whether the worker can serve `state.snapshot` requests.

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied key to make run creation idempotent.

input.description: Initial user input / task context handed to the model.

parent_run_id.description: Parent run when this run is a delegated child task.

source_framework.description: Framework that produced this definition, e.g. `goshikq-python`.

task_id.description: Unique id of the delegated task (distinct from `run.id`).

trace_id.description: When set, reuse this trace instead of minting a new one (child tasks share the parent trace).

reused.description: True when an idempotency key matched an existing run.

defer_start.description: Do not spawn the child executor (SDK will call `/start` later, or approval will).

requires_approval.description: Hold the child in `CREATED` until a human approval is granted.

draft.description: When true, incomplete graphs may be stored. Publish and run still require a valid graph.

from.description: JSON pointer (RFC 6901) into the source payload, e.g. `/order/id`.

to.description: JSON pointer into the target payload.

EffectCategory.description: Effect category of an action. Drives retry safety (see ADR-003).

ErrorBody.description:
Consistent error envelope for every endpoint. Messages never include secrets or
internal SQL.

EventBatch.description: Batch ingestion request for external frameworks and SDK-side emitters.

EventBatchResult.description: Result of an idempotent batch ingestion.

EventStatus.description: Coarse status attached to an event. Interpretation depends on the event type.

EventType.description:
Closed list of event types for protocol schema version 1.x.

Unknown types are rejected at ingestion with a descriptive error; readers of a newer
minor version must ignore types they do not understand.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier; deduplication key for ingestion.

sequence.description:
Per-run monotonic sequence. Allocated by the runtime for native runs and by the
collector (arrival order) for external runs.

timestamp.description: Source timestamp (UTC). Ingestion time is stored separately by the collector.

deadline_seconds.description: Wall-clock deadline for the whole run, in seconds.

external_wait_seconds.description: Bound on waiting for external settlement without burning model steps.

max_cost_usd.description: Estimated cost budget in USD, enforced only when pricing is known.

max_replans.description: Maximum consecutive replans after the model claims completion but the goal is unmet.

max_tool_result_bytes.description: Maximum serialized size of a tool result accepted into context, in bytes.

max_total_tokens.description: Total token budget (input + output) across all model calls, when usage is reported.

FrameworkCapabilityManifest.description:
Published by every adapter. Studio renders these as indicators, not as health of the
remote framework itself.

framework_version.description: Framework release the adapter was tested against, or `unknown`.

notes.description: Human-readable limits. Missing data stays unknown.

external_wait_seconds.description: Bound on waiting for external settlement (seconds). Min'd with agent limits.

invariants.description: Names of invariants implemented by the worker.

success_predicate.description: Name of the success predicate implemented by the worker, if any.

cancel_source.description: When true, cancel the handing-off run after the successor is created.

ModelMessage.description: Normalized chat message exchanged with model adapters.

tool_call_id.description: For `tool` role messages: the id of the tool call being answered.

cached_input_per_million.description: USD per 1,000,000 cached input tokens, when the provider reports cached usage.

ModelToolSchema.description: Tool schema as presented to the model (name/description/parameters only).

adapters.description: Adapter capability manifest shipped with the SDKs (config/model-adapters.json).

OutcomeContract.description:
Canonical outcome contract returned by the verification API.
The five fields are independent: a tool may succeed while the goal is unverified.

total_estimated_cost_usd.description: Sum over runs with known cost (estimated).

total_input_tokens.description: Sum over runs with known usage.

usage_known_runs.description: Runs whose usage is fully known.

verification_overhead_ms.description: Sum of verification_results.duration_ms; NULL when no timed verification rows exist.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier; deduplication key for ingestion.

sequence.description:
Per-run monotonic sequence. Allocated by the runtime for native runs and by the
collector (arrival order) for external runs.

timestamp.description: Source timestamp (UTC). Ingestion time is stored separately by the collector.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated; `null` when pricing is unknown for any call in the run.

usage_known.description: False when at least one model call did not report usage; token totals are then partial.

models.description:
Keyed by provider-qualified model identifier. A key ending in `/*` matches any
model of that provider.

version.description: Free-form version label recorded on every cost record, e.g. `2026-10-27`.

RecoveryReport.description: Current-state projection returned by the recovery API.

RequiredEvidence.description: One declared requirement. Not an assertion that no other facts matter.

authorization.description: This item is authorization evidence (approval token, authority record).

dry_run.description: When omitted or true, candidates are returned and nothing is deleted.

older_than_days.description: Terminal runs whose `ended_at` is older than this many days. Defaults to `GOSHIKQ_RETENTION_DAYS`.

only_run_ids.description: Optional allowlist. When set, only these ids are considered.

max_attempts.description: Maximum attempts including the first one.

RevalidationPolicy.description:
How the executor revalidates before a sensitive write.
Distinct from [`crate::VerificationPolicy`] (goal verification).

definition.description: The full `CreateRunRequest` as submitted (agent + goal contracts).

inferred.description: Edges are stored relationships, not inferred LLM traces.

framework_overhead_ms.description: duration - (model latency + tool duration); only meaningful when both are known.

RunStatus.description: Execution lifecycle status of a run. Transition rules live in `goshikq-core`.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated; `null` when pricing is unknown for any call in the run.

usage_known.description: False when at least one model call did not report usage; token totals are then partial.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of why the run has its verification status.

outcome.description: Canonical five-way outcome contract. Fields are independent.

SharedContextPut.description: Optimistic-concurrency write of a shared-context key.

evidence_refs.description: Resource ids in the existing evidence graph this value depends on.

expected_version.description: When set, the write fails with conflict unless the stored version matches.

ToolCall.description: A tool call proposed by the model. Treated as an untrusted suggestion.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this logical action; identical across retries of the same call.

ToolSpec.description: Action contract registered with the runtime for a tool exposed by the SDK worker.

oneOf.description: Declared evidence requirements. Completeness of this list is not completeness of reality.

has_verifier.description: The SDK registered an outcome verifier for this action.

idempotent.description: The tool/API honors the `idempotency_key` passed by the runtime.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 or draft-07) for the arguments object.

preconditions.description:
Names of preconditions evaluated by the worker before execution (informational;
evaluated by the SDK, reported in `tool.validated`).

revalidation_policy.description: How this tool is revalidated before a write. Default preserves v0.3 selective behavior.

TrustClassification.description: How much the runtime should trust an evidence record.

VerificationPolicy.description: Whether the goal requires authoritative verification to count as completed.

WorkerError.description: Structured error returned by a worker for any request kind.

retryable.description: The worker asserts the operation did not take effect and may be retried.

timeout_ms.description: Deadline after which the runtime stops waiting for this request.

id.description: Optional identity assigned by the catalog. Ignored on import until saved.

max_steps.description: Upper bound on total node executions for one workflow run.

config.description: Kind-specific configuration (agent name, tool name, condition expression, ...).

max_iterations.description: Required for nodes that participate in a cycle.
